description: The escalation posture: effort `ultra`, the top of Astra's six-level scale and the level at which the model may delegate work to sub-tasks of its own. Published write-ups list five efforts and omit it; this build's own model catalog is what says it exists, and expressing it at all requires Codex CLI 0.155.0 or newer. Compaction drops to 160K rather than rising, because `ultra` spends more tokens per turn and reaches the 272K surcharge threshold sooner. Fast mode is left unset on purpose: it multiplies every applicable rate by two and compounds with that same threshold.
